name: OpenAI Chat Completions function calling

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Retrieves current weather for the given location.

fields.function.name: required; a-z, A-Z, 0-9, underscores and dashes, max length 64
fields.function.description: optional; used by the model to choose when/how to call
fields.function.parameters: optional; JSON Schema object. Omitting it defines a function with an empty parameter list
fields.function.strict: optional, default false; strict schema adherence (Chat Completions is non-strict by default)

tool_result.error: No dedicated error flag documented; errors are conveyed in the tool message content (string or array of text parts).

name_rule: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ (doc text: 'Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64')
schema_rules: function.arguments is a JSON string; docs warn the model may produce invalid JSON or hallucinate params - validate before calling (non-strict).
Strict mode: additionalProperties must be false for every object in parameters.
Strict mode: all fields in properties must be listed in required; emulate optional with a null union, e.g. "type": ["string","null"].

Strict subset types: string, number, boolean, integer, object, array, enum, anyOf. Supported: string pattern/format (e.g. date-time, email, uuid); number multipleOf/maximum/exclusiveMaximum/minimum/exclusiveMinimum; array minItems/maxItems; $defs + $ref; recursion via # or $defs.
Strict NOT supported: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if/then/else. Unsupported schema with strict: true -> error.
Strict: root must be an object and must not use anyOf.

Strict limits: up to 5000 object properties total, 10 levels of nesting; total chars of property names+definition names+enum values+const values <= 120,000; <= 1000 enum values total; a single string enum with >250 values capped at 15,000 chars.

sources.what: tools[].function fields, name rule (max 64), tool_calls shape, role:tool message, omitting parameters
